notes: Point Horror recap confirms the birthday breakfast in bed Andy makes (blackened toast, overflowing cereal, orange juice), the $50 to $30 haggle, Maggie eating the birthday cake while babysitting, the L train and John Bishop about to make tea. The mimosa line's 'poured by Andy' is a fair read since he makes the whole tray. Menu still is Karen and Andy with Chucky, not poster art.

vibe.verdict: A birthday invite RSVP'd by Chucky is a great frame and the breakfast moments land, though the griot and mac and cheese feel bolted on.
missing: Maggie hit with a hammer and out the window (the babysitting night)
Karen threatens to throw Chucky in the fire and finds no batteries
'We're friends until the end, remember?' (Chucky, in the fire)
The voodoo doll torture of John (John's house)
Chucky shot through the heart (the finale)
ideas: Swap the place card 'Seated near: Damballa and the lightning' for 'Seated near: Friends until the end'
Swap the mac and cheese note 'Andy wanted a Good Guy so badly.' for 'Batteries fell out of the box.'
Swap 'A POT OF TEA FOR JOHN' note to 'He taught Charles the spell. He regrets it.'
